# Abolfazl Nasiri Almas — Software Engineer Portfolio

Canonical site: https://almas98abolfazl.ir

This is the public portfolio and technical writing site of Abolfazl Nasiri Almas, a full-stack software engineer. The site provides portfolio information, project case studies, articles, videos, and contact details. It supports Persian (RTL) and English (LTR) presentation.

## Public routes

- [Home](https://almas98abolfazl.ir/): introduction, selected experience, skills, and testimonials.
- [About me](https://almas98abolfazl.ir/about-me): biography, experience, education, skills, and contact information. The sections are available through the page tabs, including `?tab=experience`, `?tab=education`, `?tab=skills`, and `?tab=contact`.
- [Blog](https://almas98abolfazl.ir/blog): published technical articles. Individual articles use `https://almas98abolfazl.ir/blog/{slug}`.
- [Projects](https://almas98abolfazl.ir/projects): public portfolio projects. Individual project pages use `https://almas98abolfazl.ir/projects/{id}`.
- [Videos](https://almas98abolfazl.ir/videos): published video content.

## Content notes

- Only published articles are public; drafts are not part of the public site.
- Article pages can contain Markdown content, images, code blocks, tables, lists, quotations, and Persian/English mixed text.
- Existing legacy URLs `/experiences` and `/skills` redirect to `/about-me`; use the About me route above as the canonical source.

## Crawling guidance

- Prefer the canonical URLs above.
- Public static pages, published article pages, and public project pages are prerendered at build time when available.
- The admin panel and API endpoints are not public content routes.
